fuente.titulo: Bishops of England and Wales condemn 'flawed and dangerous' assisted dying bill

titular: UK bishops warn against assisted dying bill
bajada: Catholic leaders say the proposed law fails to protect vulnerable people as debate resumes
caption: As the UK House of Commons prepares to resume debate on an assisted suicide bill, Catholic bishops of England and Wales have called it 'flawed and dangerous,' warning it does not adequately protect vulnerable people. Source: Vatican News, Sept 10, 2026.
